children: TOKYO, October 16 (Reuters) - Foreign investors remained netbuyers of Japanese stocks for the week ending on October 10, capital flows data showed on Friday.    Foreigners bought a net 3,521.5 billion yen worth of shares inthe week through Oct. 10, after buying a net 2,199.7 billion yenin the week before that.    Japanese investors sold a net 339.7 billion yen of foreignbonds in the latest week after selling a net 345.7 billion yenthe week before.    Details of net investments were as follows (in billion yen):

FOREIGN INVESTMENT IN JAPAN:    (net)                                       stocks         bonds        bills    October 4  - October 10          +3,521.5      +1,080.1       +841.6     September 27 - October 3         +2,199.7r       +608.1r      -238.5
JAPANESE INVESTMENT ABROAD:    (net; a minus sign indicates net selling and inflows of funds into Japan)
stocks         bonds        bills    October 4  - October 10            -760.6        -339.7        +70.3     September 27 - October 3         +1,328.6r       -345.7r      -156.0

Notes:    - An "r" denotes a revised figure.    - Bonds include beneficiary certificates.    - Figures are based on contracts and are rounded.    - The MOF's capital flows data can be found in English at:    http://www.mof.go.jp/international_policy/reference/itn_transactions_in_securities/week.pdf
